---
title: "Dataschema"
---

The dataschema (`harmonisation/dataschema.csv`) defines every variable in the harmonised analysis dataset: its name, meaning, type, units, and allowed values.
Each dataset's `variables.csv` must explain how it derives each of these variables — see [Harmonising variables](../guides/harmonisation.qmd).

This table is generated from the CSV on every site build, so it is always current.
Use the search box and column filters to find variables; the `domain` column groups related variables (screen time, wellbeing, demographics, …), and `core = TRUE` marks variables prioritised for harmonisation in every dataset.

```{r}
#| label: dataschema-table
#| column: page
dataschema <- readr::read_csv(
  "../harmonisation/dataschema.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
DT::datatable(
  dataschema,
  filter = "top",
  rownames = FALSE,
  options = list(
    pageLength = 25,
    scrollX = TRUE,
    autoWidth = FALSE
  )
)
```

## Column meanings

| Column | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| `variable_name` | The harmonised column name (unique). |
| `label` / `description` | Short label and full definition of the construct. |
| `domain` | Thematic grouping (e.g. `screen_time`, `wellbeing`, `demographics`). |
| `entity` | What one value describes: a `participant`, a `study`, or the `dataset`. |
| `data_type` | Storage type (`double` or `character`); harmonised values are cast to this type. |
| `unit` | Measurement unit where applicable (e.g. minutes/day). |
| `allowed_values` | Pipe-delimited set of valid values for categorical variables. |
| `min_value` / `max_value` | Plausible range for numeric variables. |
| `missing_rule` | What to do when the value cannot be derived. |
| `core` | Whether the variable is prioritised for harmonisation in every dataset. |
| `notes` | Guidance for harmonisers. |

Changing the dataschema is a project-level decision: adding a variable requires a row in every dataset's `variables.csv` (run `sync_harmonisation_vars()` to add them as `in_progress`), and significant definition changes should be recorded in the [decision register](../decisions/README.md).
